_comment: Single source of truth for open roles. build.py turns each OPEN job into JobPosting structured data on its page, an ItemList on /apply/, and the /jobs.json + /jobs.xml feeds. To close a role set status to "closed" (it then disappears from all of them). Keep every fact here identical to what is visible on the job page.

jobs.title: Storekeeping Assistant
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Storekeeping Assistant for a production company in Kuje, Abuja.
responsibilities: Receive, check and record incoming materials and finished goods.
Issue items to production staff and keep accurate stock records.
Keep the store clean, organised and secure, and report any shortages.
benefits: Hands-on experience in a production company.
